name: ine-price-tracker
description: Product price tracker for the INE mock storefront — reliable scheduled scraping, honest logging, live price history.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w backend & npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
